rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for a sturdy table used for hands-on work.

example.english: This workbench is sturdy enough for metalwork.
example.traditional: 呢張工作枱夠結實，做金工都頂得住。
example.jyutping: nei1 zoeng1 gung1 zok3 toi2 gau3 git3 sat6 zou6 gam1 gung1 dou1 ding2 dak1 zyu6

rows.note: Use this when the workbench is specifically for carpentry or woodworking rather than general manual work.

example.english: I’m sawing a board at the workbench.
example.traditional: 我喺木工枱度鋸緊塊木板。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 muk6 gung1 toi2 dou6 geoi3 gan2 faai3 muk6 baan2
